body.title: SQL injection in report filter (Patient portal)
body.description: While testing Patient portal with two synthetic test accounts I found that it does not check who is asking.
body.impact: Someone signed in as one customer could read or change another customer's data. Illustrative impact for the demo.
body.steps:
1. Sign in to Patient portal as synthetic account A.
2. Repeat the request below while signed in as account B.
3. The response still contains account A's data.
body.httpRequest:
GET /api/records/1000 HTTP/1.1
Host: portal.atlas-clinic.example
Cookie: session=[REDACTED]

body.impact: Someone signed in as one customer could read or change another customer's data. Illustrative impact for the demo.
body.steps:
1. Sign in to Mobile API as synthetic account A.
2. Repeat the request below while signed in as account B.
3. The response still contains account A's data.
body.httpRequest:
GET /api/records/1041 HTTP/1.1
Host: m.basket.example
Cookie: session=[REDACTED]
